title: Dragonbone
body:
Dragonbone

"Crafted from dragon remains, it terrifies goblins and skeletons alike"

The Dragonbone is a weapon that can be used in the Acidlands to fight mobs and drops exclusively from Skeletons. The attack is similar to that of the Wooden Sword however deals slightly more damage. The small size of the weapon makes it great for attacking quickly and dealing with single target enemies rather than a group.

Although the drop chance is unknown its estimated to have a drop chance of about 10%. Or about 1 in 10 kills (1/10).
